projects.label: Portfolio
projects.title: Featured
projects.description: Real high-impact systems, from marketing management platforms to desktop apps with hardware integration.

marketing.name: Marketing Management System
marketing.subtitle: Digital Marketing Management – Depilab
marketing.description: Fullstack platform to manage and analyze Depilab's marketing: real-time metrics on appointments and revenue, campaign creation, influencer coupon management and automated social media scraping with Playwright.
features: Real-time metrics: appointments, campaigns and revenue
Automated influencer social media scraping with Playwright
Discount coupon and campaign management
Redis cache for high-traffic queries

tracking.name: Traffic & Conversion Tracking
tracking.subtitle: Advanced Web Analytics – Depilab
tracking.description: Tracking system embedded in Depilab's website to identify the origin of each visit: UTM campaigns, Google, social media or direct traffic. Tracks the full funnel from first visit to purchase.
features: Source identification: UTM, campaigns, Google, direct
Full funnel: visit → cart → booking → purchase
First and last interaction tracking per user
Time tracking at each funnel stage

citas.name: Appointment Funnel Tracking
citas.subtitle: Booking Analytics – Depilab
citas.description: Step-by-step analysis of Depilab's booking flow. Records at which step each user drops off, time spent per stage and final conversion rate to optimize the scheduling process.
features: Step-by-step booking flow tracking
Drop-off analysis per stage with conversion rates
Average time spent per step
Bottleneck identification in the process

emails.name: Transactional Email System
emails.subtitle: Email Infrastructure – Depilab
emails.description: Complete transactional email system with AWS SES as provider and Mautic as orchestrator. Covers all customer lifecycle events deployed in Docker containers.
features: Welcome, recovery and verification emails
Booked and rescheduled appointment notifications
Purchase confirmations and receipts
Mautic orchestration with AWS SES delivery

desktop.name: Depilab Sede App
desktop.subtitle: Desktop App + PinPad – Depilab
desktop.description: Electron application for Depilab physical branches. The receptionist selects the branch and seller, the customer scans a QR to log into the tablet and make an appointment or purchase. Includes native Niubiz Lane 7000 PinPad integration for in-branch payments.
features: QR login for customers from the branch tablet
Niubiz Lane 7000 PinPad integration for in-person payments
Automatic branch detection by internet IP
Real-time tablet streaming via WebSockets

restcabana.name: RestCabaña
restcabana.subtitle: Restaurant Management System
restcabana.description: Complete mobile application for comprehensive restaurant management. Includes inventory control, order management, sales reports and staff administration, with a NestJS backend and React Native app.
features: Complete REST API with JWT authentication
iOS and Android mobile app with React Native
Integrated payment gateway
Real-time sales and inventory reports
